The '''Circarpous sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], [[Circarpous IV]] and [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]].

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the sector was ruled by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bin Essada/Legends|Bin Essada]], based on Gyndine.<ref name="FaDCR" />
